blocks.title: Generate and Test
blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm masle ke mumkina hal banata aur har ek ko jaanchta hai ke sharait poori karta hai ya nahi, aur yeh tab tak jari rehta hai jab tak tasalli bakhsh hal na mile ya tamam imkanaat khatam na hon.
Yeh seedha aur aasani se samajh aane wala tareeqa hai jo artificial intelligence aur computer science mein aam istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Generate and test kab rukta hai?
blocks.explanation: Jab koi umeedwar hal test paas kare, ya jab tamam mumkina hal aazmaye ja chuke hon.

items: Generate and test: umeedwar pesh karo, jaancho, dohrao jab tak koi chal jaye ya koi na bache.
